items.title: Magic To Sign Kevin Porter Jr.
items.summary: The Magic and free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr. have reached an agreement on a two-year deal, agent Sam Permut of Roc Nation tells Shams Charania of ESPN (Twitter link). The Magic and Nuggets were identified earlier this week by Michael Scotto of HoopsHype as teams eyeing Porter, who has been a free agent since he was waived by Milwaukee at the end of the preseason last month. According to Charania (Twitter link), Porter met with both teams earlier in the week before making the decision to sign with Orlando. The 30th overall pick in the 2019 draft, Porter has averaged 14.4 points, 4.9 assists, and 4.3 rebounds in 28.1 minutes per game over the course of 309 total NBA appearances (186 starts) for the Cavaliers, Rockets, Clippers, and Bucks. items.summary: Former No. 1 overall pick Markelle Fultz is rejoining the Raptors 905, Toronto’s G League affiliate, reports Michael Scotto of HoopsHype (Twitter link).
